ablation.name: phase4i7a_cosine_heun_a09_5ep
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.7a: cosine + Heun + alpha=0.9 + 5ep. STRATEGIC: cosine schedule bought 0.0058 lpips improvement over linear (4I.5b). Spend this 'content budget' on higher alpha for more style. If alpha 0.8->0.9 gives +0.003 clip and +0.004 lpips, net result: clip~0.729, lpips~0.321 — both significantly beat SaMam (clip=0.7222, lpips=0.3282). Tests if cosine+alpha tradeoff is more efficient than linear+alpha.
